receipt.public_excerpt: Construction began in September of last year and, as of this month, seven buildings are already online, with two more campuses underway.

evidence_items.explanation: CNBC disclosed the operational building count and continued construction; the following sentence described an eventual 30-building site. That is material countercontext, though it cannot determine the prevalence or audience effect of misleading impressions.

receipt.public_excerpt: Spread across multiple data centers in the United States, the sheer size of the project is unlike anything AWS has ever attempted before.

evidence_items.explanation: Amazon identifies Rainier as a distributed compute project. An operational cluster and an unfinished campus can coexist, so their different completion states alone do not prove deception.
